# Workspace codec reference

The literal DXF is hand-authored to distinguish VPORT array order, UCS and dormant drawing aids, two Paper block owners and positive viewport status ranks. It is not derived from converter output and is not a structurally complete native-drawing conversion fixture. Typed fresh CadDocument cases separately qualify complete layout infrastructure and actual DXF/AC1032 DWG readers.

Base: upstream opencadcodec 063c10671fe7833d562f772159771318c7a0ebb9 (0.6.0), with the repository's explicit viewport-off repair only. No historical 0001/0002 patches, cache edits or size measurements.
